title: Welcome to JPTBeat!
author: John Doe
content: Welcome to JPTBeat, an unofficial student-run news source for JP Taravella High School!

Here, you’ll find stories, photos, opinions, and journalism covering what’s happening around campus. Whether it’s school events, student activities, interesting stories, or something you think the Taravella community should know about, JPTBeat is here to give students a place to share it.
Have a story, photo, or idea you think we should cover? Send it to jptbeat@gmail.com, and it could become our next article!
Want to submit something anonymously? That’s completely okay. Just let us know when you submit it.
JPTBeat is made by students, for students. Thanks for reading, and welcome to JPTBeat!
